title: Thousands of Microsoft 365 users report email access problems as company investigates
text:

Using deprecated PresentationRouter. Thousands of Microsoft 365 users report email access problems as company investigates
 by JESSICA A. BOTELHO | The National News Desk
 Thu, November 12th 2026 at 1:56 PM Updated Thu, November 12th 2026 at 2:50 PM 7 VIEW ALL PHOTOS FILE - A Microsoft sign is seen at the Deutsche Telekom's Digital X event at MediaPark on September 19, 2024 in Cologne, Germany. (Photo by Sascha Schuermann/Getty Images) TOPICS:
 Microsoft Outlook Exchange Online Email outage Connectivity errors Downdetector Service update Network logs Microsoft 365 users reported trouble accessing their email on Thursday as the company investigated connection problems affecting part of its Exchange Online service.
 "We're investigating reports of users experiencing issues accessing Exchange Online mailboxes through multiple connection methods in the Americas," "More details can be found in the Microsoft 365 admin center under EX1550543." There was a spike in outage complaints on Downdetector , including users who said they could not sign in or encountered error messages. There were more than 130,000 users reporting outages as of 2 p.m. EST.
 Microsoft said connectivity errors were occurring in part of the Exchange Online infrastructure that receives and processes user access requests. The issue could affect people trying to reach their mailboxes through certain connection methods, the company said in a service update . 
 Microsoft also said it was reviewing network logs to determine the source of the errors and its next steps. 
 The company did not immediately provide an estimate for when the issue would be resolved.
